scope: Uniqueness of positive roots in the resolvent-constructed class and, equivalently for this proof, roots represented by positive normalized bounded graph pairs; equality of partial operators includes exact domains. Not unrestricted Kato.
reuse: V350ResolventSquareRoot already constructs closed dense self-adjoint positive roots and squares them exactly to resolventGraphOperator.
ContinuousModularResolvent already constructs bounded CFC roots and the exponential multiplier graph; no reconstruction was repeated.

V350ScalarTomitaPositiveRoot already builds the actual scalar GNS root of S dagger S. RootDomain already establishes D(root)=D(S); PolarFactor already gives S=U root on D(S). These remain reused results, not new achievements.
new_content: The full graph determines its bounded resolvent R: solving x+y=u gives x=R u.
Equality of full squares forces equality of R and hence of the constructed roots, not just equality on a core.
For positive A,B with A injective and A*A+B*B=1, boundedGraphOperator(A,B) is exactly resolventSquareRoot(A*A). No commutation premise or root-equality premise is assumed.
Positive normalized graph roots with equal full squares are equal.
T_c is identified with its canonical resolvent root; every parameter c inhabits the root class.
The two uniqueness forms specialize to the actual scalarTomitaSquare and scalarTomitaPositiveRoot on the same ScalarGNSHilbert P.
nonvacuity: continuous_root_class_inhabited holds for every real c.
finite_nonzero_root_witness constructs R=(1/2) identity on complex Hilbert line, positive injective contraction, with a domain vector whose root image is nonzero.
remaining_open: Unrestricted uniqueness among all abstract positive self-adjoint closed unbounded operators: not proved here.
Missing general step: derive positive normalized bounded graph coordinates for an arbitrary positive self-adjoint root, without postulating the representation.
No numerical mass selection, physical energy calibration, H3 derivation from state, canonical full physical witness, empirical sigma or scientific gate change follows from these uniqueness theorems.
concrete_program_consequence: Constructive comparisons of roots in the two proved representation classes can now use kernel terms instead of invoking unrestricted Kato. Existing GNS root-domain and polar-factor results transfer by equality. The unrestricted citation status must remain until the general representation step is proved.
